PuduBot, Best-selling commercial service robot

PuduBot 2, the newly upgraded delivery robot from Pudu Robotics, inherits the excellent features of PuduBot. PuduBot 2 is committed to realizing intelligent deliveries in all scenarios, promoting the application of service robots, and accelerating the overall robot development with higher performance, better extendability, adaptability, and reliability.
